# QR Code generator

- Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Commit: `3c6d0b3cefb4e049dc337e82237c9644399716a8`
- Imported files: `c/qrcodegen.c`, `c/qrcodegen.h`
